_source: One-time import (2026-11-04) of the DAO Treasury's end-of-day ATLAS balance. Until 2024-08-09 from Dune (solana_utils.daily_balances), after that from a daily balance record kept by ryden.systems. Checked against this dashboard's own chain rebuild: Treasury USDC (1,269 days) and Ecosystem Fund ATLAS (763 days) match exactly. From 2026-10-09 on, the dashboard's own daily snapshots (balances.json) take over. This file is never updated by the build.
